scripts.psql: docker compose exec db psql -U ruina ruina
scripts.build: npm run engine && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.test:unit: npm run engine && vitest run --project unit && npm run test:rust
scripts.test:conformance: node tools/cargo.mjs build --release && npm run engine && vitest run --project conformance
scripts.cluster: node tools/cargo.mjs build --release --bin ruina-server && node tools/cluster/run.mjs
scripts.test:cluster: node tools/cargo.mjs test -p ruina-server --test leases --test cluster -- --ignored --test-threads=1
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:conformance && npm run test:integration && npm run test:stress
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run deadcode && npm run lint:rust && npm run test:unit
scripts.check:beta: npm run check && npm run test:conformance && npm run test:integration
scripts.check:release: npm run check:beta && npm run test:stress
scripts.loadtest: node tools/cargo.mjs build --release -p ruina-server && node tools/cargo.mjs run --release --bin loadtest --
scripts.lint:rust: node tools/cargo.mjs fmt --all --check && node tools/cargo.mjs clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
